products.name: Browse AI
products.note: Web scraping automation; data extraction; monitoring; terms-of-service compliance risk

profile_text.body:
Browse AI is a no-code web scraping and monitoring platform founded in 2020. The company describes itself as enabling users to scrape data from websites, monitor pages for changes, and turn websites into live datasets or APIs without writing any code. Its approach centers on training automated "robots" by pointing them at a webpage, after which the platform structures the extracted data automatically. The site highlights features including dynamic content capture, built-in bot evasion, proxy management, automatic retries, rate limiting, and integrations with Google Sheets, Zapier, and REST APIs.

The company's core product, also called Browse AI, is categorized as an automation and agents tool. The platform uses AI to adapt automatically when a target website changes its layout, which the company describes as preventing data pipelines from breaking. Users can configure change-detection monitors to trigger alerts based on the scale of a detected change. Pre-built robot templates for specific sites, such as Best Buy product listings and Google Translate bulk translation, are offered alongside the general scraping tool. The held facts note a terms-of-service compliance risk associated with the product, reflecting the inherent tension between automated web scraping and the policies of target websites.

No litigation, SEC filings, MCP server registrations, or patent records are present in the available data for Browse AI.
